messages:
alicia: quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime section — can someone clarify the kernel-v4 canary plan? specifically how are we validating p99/throughput vs staging and what's the rollback trigger?

suresh: short version: canary running in prod-limited for a rolling 2h window. we'll compare p50/p90/p99 + success rate against baseline and synthetic traces. rollback if p99 > baseline + 15ms OR error rate > 0.05% over 30m. details below.

tom: note — autoscaler will be disabled for canary so we get consistent batching numbers (no scale flapping).

maria: from leadership: promote only if perf + correctness checks pass and there are no e2e regression signals. also need an explicit KV-cache edge-case test before promo.

alicia: where will the canary dashboard live? link pls.

suresh: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/canary/1973456789
also smoke test command (use a test token):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/test/concat -d '{"prompt":"latency test"}'
```
log x-request-id to correlate traces.

jane: on batching: are we increasing max batch size or tuning wait-time? customers reported ~20% tail regression on short requests in the preview.

tom: for the canary we're lowering max batch from 128 -> 96 and dropping batch wait 12ms -> 8ms. expect ~3% throughput hit but tighter tail.

suresh: KV cache: we'll enable prefix warming for hot keys. TTL stays 60s but fallback policy moves to LRU-with-prefetch so we avoid thundering cold misses.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-v4-canary started on cluster-prod-limited at 1973456805

maria: action items: suresh to post canary runbook + test checklist, tom to flip autoscaler flag, eng-oncall to monitor traces and alert if thresholds hit. reconvene in ~45m.

alicia: thanks — ping @eng-oncall when you kick off. and maybe add an emoji-heavy prompt perf test for fun :grin: (low priority)

suresh: runbook posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/kernel-v4-canary — includes test vectors and rollback playbook.

ops-bot: ops-alert: p99 increased 18ms in cluster-prod-limited at 1973456860 — investigating.

tom: seeing transient tail in rack-3, rolling one node group back to kernel-v3 to isolate. will update once rollback completes.

suresh: rollback done for the affected nodes. we'll rerun with lower batch headroom and collect new traces. stub postmortem here: https://docs.redwood.ai/pm/kernel-v4-canary — team will fill details.

alicia: appreciate the fast triage. keep this thread posted if anything else pops up.
